topic: E-130J TACAMO prime-contract award timing and status
public_statement: On 21 Oct 2024, NAVAIR stated that the E-130J integration solicitation had closed and that contract award was scheduled for January 2025.
internal_content: The DoD contract announcement for 18 Dec 2024 records award of contract N0001925C0130 to Northrop Grumman Systems Corp. for E-130J TACAMO engineering and manufacturing development, with a stated value of $3,459,276,000.
notes: The award occurred before the month forecast in the October planning statement. This resolves award status only; it does not establish later contract performance, aircraft delivery, operational readiness, nuclear-use authority, or mission employment.
